what_it_does: Bharat Electronics Limited provides advanced electronic products, systems, and solutions to the Indian armed forces and civilian sectors. It generates revenue by selling defence and non-defence electronic equipment, systems, and related services, while also pursuing export opportunities.
other_facts: Total of 9 manufacturing units performed well during FY 2025-26.
Export sales turnover reached US$ 141.96 Million in FY 2025-26.
Total Strategic Business Units (SBUs) stood at 30.
